def fix_spaces(text):
    new_text = ''
    i = 0
    start, end = (0, 0)
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == ' ':
            end += 1
        else:
            if end - start > 2:
                new_text += '-' + text[i]
            elif end - start > 0:
                new_text += '_' * (end - start) + text[i]
            else:
                new_text += text[i]
            start, end = (i + 1, i + 1)
        i += 1
    if end - start > 2:
        new_text += '-'
    elif end - start > 0:
        new_text += '_'
    return new_text
